title: A pull request that already has its stage label keeps that label
description: A pull request that already has its stage label keeps that label
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-070 already says the script applies the one main stage and removes every other chough-stage label. The script removes the matching label and adds it again. This change makes the script match that sentence. The requirement text stays as it is.
acceptance_criteria: A pull request that already has chough-stage:build, and whose introduced session is build, is not edited: the script does not remove that label and does not add it. A different chough-stage label on that pull request is still removed. The two script copies stay byte-identical.

answers.constraints: tasks.md has no unchecked boxes. The two script copies stay byte-identical. REQ-cli-070 already requires removing every other stage label.
